title: Add ingest fast-path and profile hint translator to accelerate onboarding
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: onboarding new model variants from partners and fast internal experiments was repeatedly blocked by a heavy canonicalization and validation path that duplicated work performed by the intake teams. This PR introduces a conservative ingest fast-path for trusted sources and a Profile Hint Translator that maps incoming vendor/partner metadata into our registry schema and seeded performance hints. The fast-path is gated behind an allowlist and feature flag; it short-circuits non-essential transforms and defers expensive fingerprinting to an async job. The hint translator performs fuzzy mapping of fields (e.g. 'seq_len', 'context_window' variants) and synthesizes initial perf profiles using a small sampled workload harness so that newly onboarded variants show up in the console with realistic baseline latency and throughput estimates. The PR also adds an automated changelog snippet generator for intake events so releases contain concise human-readable onboarding notes.

What changed (high level): added ingest/fastpath orchestrator and guard, implemented hint_translator with mapping rules and confidence scoring, introduced sampled-harness to generate quick perf stamps (micro-sample only), added onboarding changelog draft generator and console metadata fields for "hint_confidence", updated docs and tests.

Safety & guardrails: feature flag (registry.features.ingest_fastpath) and a curated allowlist for trusted accounts, runtime audits emitted to telemetry (audit.ingest.fastpath), fallback to full ingestion on translation confidence < 0.6, mandatory post-ingest async fingerprint job that can mark variants 'pending' if anomalies found.

Testing & rollout: unit tests for mapping rules and confidence thresholds included, integration tests simulate partner payloads, synthetic perf sampler included in CI with mocked hardware. Rollout plan: enable feature flag in internal staging, release to 10 trusted partners, monitor audit.metrics and profile regression alerts for 2 weeks, then widen allowlist. Rollback: disable feature flag and run async reconcile to re-run full ingestion for any variants that were fast-pathed.
